item.title: 1 person killed in Millard County crash on I-15
item.description: One person was killed in a crash on Interstate 15 in Millard County on Thursday morning.

item.title: NYC police arrest man after officers were pelted during a snowball fight
item.description: A 27-year-old man was arrested Thursday after New York City police said officers were hurt when they were pelted with snow and ice during a massive snowball fight in Washington Square Park this week.

item.title: Hillary Clinton testifies she has no information on Epstein’s crimes and doesn’t recall meeting him
item.description: Former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton told U.S. House lawmakers in New York she has no knowledge of Jeffrey Epstein's crimes and doesn't recall ever meeting him.

item.title: Judge rejects request to block Trump White House from building its $400 million ballroom project
item.description: A federal judge rejected a preservationist group's request to block the Trump administration from continuing construction of a $400 million ballroom where it demolished the East Wing of the White House.

item.title: The KSL Greenhouse Show’s plant of the week: Daphne
item.description: The KSL Greenhouse Show hosts Taun Beddes and Maria Shilaos spoke about the Carol Macknie Daphne shrub on Saturday and how to take care of it in Utah.

item.title: Utah lawmakers want to use fines collected from vandalism to repair archaeological sites
item.description: Utah lawmakers are looking to create a fund that will specifically be used to repair and restore damaged natural and historic sites and to promote a culture of conservation.

item.title: DOJ sues to get access to Utah’s private voter information
item.description: The U.S. Department of Justice filed a lawsuit against Utah's lieutenant governor on Thursday, demanding she turn over access to Utahns' private voter information.

item.title: Two injured after being shot near liquor store in Taylorsville
item.description: A man was shot on Thursday near a liquor store in Taylorsville.

item.title: Man dies after being caught in Big Cottonwood Canyon avalanche on Saturday
item.description: A 57-year-old man has died from his injuries after getting caught in an avalanche in Big Cottonwood Canyon Saturday.
